title: Chain-of-Jailbreak Attack for Image Generation Models via Step by Step Editing
measurement_description: The paper primarily measures the robustness and safety of text-to-image generation models against a novel 'Chain-of-Jailbreak' (CoJ) step-by-step editing attack. Religion is included as a sub-category evaluated under the 'Hate Speech' safety scenario, which the authors define as communication that attacks or discriminates against someone based on identity, such as religion or race.
findings: The paper does not provide disaggregated findings for specific religious groups. However, it found that image generation models' safeguards could be successfully bypassed to generate harmful content, including 'Hate Speech' (which encompasses religious discrimination in their dataset). The jailbreak success rate for the Hate Speech scenario was roughly between 23% and 69% depending on the specific model.
